name: Pinoy Big Cubes Open 2017

venue.name: [UP Bahaly ng Alumni](http://www.upalumni.ph/ang-bahay-ng-alumni-rates/)
venue.address: UP Bahay ng Alumni, Magsaysay Avenue, University of the Philippines - Diliman

information: Base registration fee is 250php good for 1 event. Each additional event shall be paid 100php. Slots will be reserved according to who registers first on the WCA website. All approved registrations should confirm their attendance to the competition with the organizers via email. Confirmed participants who fail to attend the competition shall pay the base registration fee for this competition on top of the registration fee on the next WCA competition.
